superseded_measure.why_invalid: at prevalence 0.164 no class rate reaches 0.5, so the rule predicts all-negative; F1=0 there is an artefact of the threshold and not evidence of independence. Leakage is a RANKING property.

interpretation: BASE_CLASS is an INGREDIENT OF THE LABEL, not an independent covariate: y=1 requires a flood-associated semantic state and p69b builds that state as BASE_CLASS x M2. PRE_WATER is 0.0000 by construction (pre-existing water wins over any M2 response).
